acceptance: All visual gates score 3 and all numeric gates pass. No automatic suitability claim.

gates.requirement: Fitted matte-black sleeveless athletic tank top with realistic neckline, armholes, seams, fabric tension, folds and lighting.
Both old sleeves removed cleanly; no short-sleeve silhouette.
Plausible shoulders and proximal upper arms; no anatomy distortion.
Identity, hair, body proportions, pose, hands, forearms, lower clothing, thighs, environment, equipment, camera and lighting preserved.
No old white-shirt remnants anywhere, including hem, collar and cuffs.
No seams, halos, white rims, skin smears, clipping or blend discontinuities at 100% and enlarged inspection.
Production has zero changed pixels and maximum channel error 0 outside binary generation; every core production pixel equals raw; 1160x896 RGB, no alpha.

raw_policy: Preserve raw unchanged; report raw semantic preservation separately from strict pixel drift. Only production can pass exact containment.
required_evidence: enlarged collar, cuffs, shoulders and hem
job and output evidence after authorized execution
